req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length. Tests cover: (1) positive EP cases for each method verifying exact Content-Length matches len(response.data), (2) negative/NEG cases verifying wrong Content-Length values are caught, (3) BVA boundary cases for empty vs non-empty bodies and exact byte-count arithmetic. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact integer equality between Content-Length header value and actual body length, testing all five endpoints, and verifying the header exists with the correct name.

tests.name: test_get_content_length_equals_body_byte_length
expected: Content-Length equals exact byte length of response body
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_content_length_equals_body_byte_length():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl > 0

test_get_content_length_equals_body_byte_length()

tests.name: test_content_length_not_off_by_one_get
preconditions: GET /get endpoint returns a non-empty body
expected: Content-Length is exactly body_len, not body_len-1 or body_len+1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_not_off_by_one_get():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl != body_len - 1

tests.name: test_content_length_header_name_exact_case_insensitive_present
actions: Check that Content-Length header key exists (case-insensitive)
Verify value is a valid integer string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_header_name_exact_case_insensitive_present():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    header_keys_lower = [k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()]
    assert 'content-length' in header_keys_lower
    cl_value = r.headers.get('Content-Length')
    assert cl_value is not None
    cl = int(cl_value)
    assert cl == len(r.data)

test_content_length_header_name_exact_case_insensitive_present()

    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200

    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])

    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl > 0

tests.name: test_content_length_all_echo_endpoints_consistent
preconditions: All five echo endpoints are available
actions: Send appropriate request to each of /get /post /put /patch /delete
expected: All five have Content-Length == body byte length exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_all_echo_endpoints_consistent():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get', {}),
        ('POST', '/post', {'data': b'', 'content_type': 'application/json'}),
        ('PUT', '/put', {'data': b'', 'content_type': 'application/json'}),
        ('PATCH', '/patch', {'data': b'', 'content_type': 'application/json'}),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', {}),
    ]
    for method, path, kwargs in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, **kwargs)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} status={r.status_code}'
        assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers, f'{method} {path} missing Content-Length'
        cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
        body_len = len(r.data)
        assert cl == body_len, f'{method} {path}: cl={cl} body_len={body_len}'
        assert cl > 0, f'{method} {path}: cl must be > 0'

test_content_length_all_echo_endpoints_consistent()
